title: Grind size is the dial
summary: If a brew is sour, grind finer. If it is bitter, grind coarser. Almost everything else is a distraction.
body:
There are a dozen variables in a cup of coffee and eleven of them are noise. The one that is not is how finely you ground it.

Sour, thin, finishes early: the water got through too fast and left half the coffee behind. Grind finer.

Bitter, drying, sits on the back of the tongue: the water took too long and pulled out the parts you did not want. Grind coarser.

Change one notch at a time, and change nothing else while you do it. Once it tastes right, write the setting down — and then go and [make the pour-over](/blog/pour-over-at-home/) you actually wanted.
